messages:
Ethan: morning! brand new MBP M2 arriving with macOS Sonoma preinstalled. Started the setup, accepted company profile, then system prompted to update to 14.4.1 mid-Setup Assistant. After the update the Kandji profile says 'Not Installed' and the OS keeps showing a 'Complete Setup' banner that loops me back to the start. FileVault never prompted. Anyone seen this? @IT Oncall
IT Oncall: hey Ethan 44b we occasionally see firmware/setup-assistant interruptions cause the MDM enrollment to not finalize. Can you DM the serial and a quick photo of the setup screen? Also did you restore from any backup during setup?
Ethan: Serial is C02P8K2V4H8X. No restore, fresh out of box. Photo sent. The Kandji UI (in the local 'Profiles' screen) shows "Enrollment profile missing - retry enrollment".
IT Oncall: ok. Two quick fixes: (1) accept a short Okta temp-admin elevation so we can run enrollment repair commands locally, or (2) reboot into Recovery and run network-based enrollment. I'll prep an Okta approval if you want the fastest path.
Priya: if you prefer a remote-minimal step, try `sudo profiles renew -type enrollment` after accepting admin access. Sometimes Setup Assistant leaves the system in an odd state where the profile needs a renew.
Ethan: I'll take the Okta elevation. Sending :thumbsup:
Sam: opened a 90-minute Okta elevation for Ethan. Check DMs for the secure approval link.
Kandji Bot: Policy 'onboard-sonoma' pending for device C02P8K2V4H8X (applied by Sam).
Ethan: accepted the Okta elevation. What command should I run?
IT Oncall: run `sudo /usr/bin/profiles renew -type enrollment` first. If that errors, run the Kandji enroll debug: ```sudo /usr/local/bin/kandji-agent enroll --debug``` and paste output. If needed we'll push the profile from the console and trigger a remote reconcile.
Ethan: ran `profiles renew` and it returned "Enrollment renew: success" but the Setup Assistant banner still loops. Reran Kandji enroll debug and saw: "EnrollRequest: 200 OK, but DeviceState: needs_user_action - Setup Assistant not completed"
IT Oncall: thanks. That means the enrollment is present but Setup Assistant isn't finishing user setup hooks (FileVault/Recovery escrow). Quick step: go to System Settings > General > Transfer or Reset > Complete Setup and follow the prompts to finalize. If that UI is stuck, we can push a remote post-enroll script to complete escrow. Want me to push that?
Ethan: tried Complete Setup and it goes back to the language/region screen. Looks like Setup Assistant lost the user state.
IT Oncall: ok pushing a remote script to trigger the post-enroll hooks and force FileVault escrow prompt. You might see a restart. Standby.
Device Support: Pushing remote reconcile and post-enroll hook to device C02P8K2V4H8X. You may see temporary UI prompts.
Kandji Bot: Remote job "post-enroll-reconcile" queued for device C02P8K2V4H8X by Sam.
Ethan: got a redeploy prompt, accepted. Machine restarted and came back to a user login screen. FileVault escrow dialog popped and I registered my YubiKey. Setup Assistant finally completed. Kandji now shows 'Enrolled' and policies applied.
Priya: welcome aboard Ethan :tada: note for the handbook: sonoma mid-setup update can cause Setup Assistant state loss; try `profiles renew` and Okta elevation for short admin to trigger remote reconcile.
Ethan: huge thanks to IT and Sam. Leaving this note: if mac updates during Setup Assistant, don't panic: accept Okta temp-admin, run `profiles renew`, then ask IT to push post-enroll reconcile. Also expect a restart. Worked for me.
